#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    vector<int> costs;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
            costs.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (B >= cost) {
            ++ans;
            B -= cost;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
